best_match.fbbt_definition: Muscle progenitor cell of the embryo. Prior to myoblast fusion, two types can be distinguished: fusion competent and muscle founder cells.

justification: The authors' annotation 'somatic muscle primordium'. Embryonic myoblasts form the somatic muscles.
